Please read the manuscript in /papers/investigations-6/03_volterra_coefficient_dynamics/01_cluster_gap_transport/02_complex_p_mellin, and some of the recent notes. I'm wondering if there might be any conserved quantities for this hierarchy. Could you look into that question? 

Note that a parallel investigation is continuing with the research there, so please put any notes in the brainstorm folder, and record chat history in a new file. If this seems promising, we can start a new investigation around this idea.
